headline: AI used to reply. Now it acts first. Claude Duet is the start.
deck: Claude Duet checks your apps, briefs you each morning and drafts the work before you ask, then waits for your yes. If you already live in Claude, here is what changes, and what it costs.

figures.after: Microsoft 365 isn't connected yet, and Slack has limits.
figures.alt: What makes the trip from Claude to Duet. Comes with you: your memory, the skills and connectors on your Claude account, the apps you connect, and your past chats, which it can search. Stays behind: files on your computer, some Claude projects, skills that live on your own computer, custom connectors in its scheduled runs, Claude Code sessions on your laptop, and Microsoft 365, not connected yet. Claude Team and Enterprise plans don't get Duet yet.

Three good first jobs for Duet. Prep for a client meeting: it reads the invite, the last email thread and the proposal in Google Docs, and a brief lands with what to settle before the call. A weekly pipeline review: it reads your CRM and inbox, and a short note lands on which deals moved and which went quiet. Your follow-ups: it reads every thread waiting on you, and a draft for each lands for your yes. First week: let it draft, check every draft, and run it beside the way you do it now.
